clips.title: The story
paras: In Bashal'Aran, Grell Earring carries traces of the seal binding Asterion.

Wild Grells and Vile Sprites in Bashal'Aran gather scraps among the ruins and make earrings from them. Most mortals see only worthless trinkets. Asterion, an ancient night elf bound there as a tormented phantom, studies the magic lingering on the earrings. He hopes those traces will lead him to the ancient seal that imprisons him.
